Title: Magnum oecumenicum Constantiense concilium, tomus III: Rerum concilii Constantiensis de religionis et fidei momentis
Creator: Hermann von der Hardt (editor); with Jacobellus de Misa (Jakoubek of Stribro by the usual identification, which the volume does not make), Demonstratio for communion in both kinds, and the replies to it
Publisher: Francofurti et Lipsiae: in officina Christiani Genschii, typis Salomonis Schnorrii (title page, read on the page image, leaf n2)
Publication Date: 1698 (title page, read on the page image, leaf n2; the OCR garbles the year there, and the colophon at OCR line 58623 reads 'A. M. DC. XCIIX.')
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1698); the archive.org record carries the Public Domain Mark (licenseurl creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/), and the imprint date agrees
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item bub_gb_kOb4sUbDZ70C, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (2,224,282) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1698, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the Latin is fair: long s, two columns, and confusions of c and e. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: Documents on matters of faith at the Council of Constance. Jacobellus's own tract stands as Liber I inside Mauritius of Prague's treatise against him: 'Jacobelli, s. Jacobi de Misa, Demonstratio per testimonia scripturae, patrum atque doctorum, communicationem calicis in plebe Christiana esse necessariam, sub Constantiensi concilio A. 1415 edita', from OCR line 50822 to 52254, printed from a Vienna manuscript (heading at 50797-50810). Mauritius's reply begins at 52256. The rest of the volume was not mapped.
